messages:
maria: Heads up — trying a slow-roll for the eco cohort next week. Goal: reduce send spikes and stabilize open rates. Timeline: 7 days. Thoughts?

oliver: Love it. Do we have APAC windowing in the plan or is it a single global send?

maria: @oliver yes — staggered windows by region. APAC early local morning, EMEA mid-morning, NA afternoon. Aim: max 2 sends/day per segment.

jamie: Can we reuse the subject + preview combos from the spring benchmark? Those had the best warmth lift.

maria: Yes. I'll pull the top 3 variants and shorten preview text to 35 chars.

zach: Segment def check — eco cohort = >2 product touches and no trial in last 30d?

oliver: That was the previous def. Suggest adding 'visited pricing' within 14d as a high-intent signal.

maria: Good call. Updating: eco cohort = (>2 touches OR pricing visit in 14d). We'll split into two buckets: A (pricing visit) and B (touches-only). A gets hero CTA + webinar invite, B gets educational drip.

jamie: For cadence, A => 1 invite + 1 reminder; B => 3-touch nurture over 7 days.

maria: Agreed. Send windows and throttle snippet:

```
APAC: 09:00-11:00 JST
EMEA: 10:00-12:00 CET
NA: 13:00-15:00 PT
Throttle: 6k/hr per region
```

zach: What's the fallback if we see deliverability issues on send 1? Pause and tweak subject/segment?

maria: Propose: pause if bounces >2% or CTR <0.9% in first hour. If triggered, reroute remaining to toned-down subject, reduce throttle to 2k/hr, and run a quick list hygiene check.

oliver: Who owns final creative and the send config?

maria: Jamie owns copy, Oliver owns cadence and scheduling, Zach owns segment logic and QA.

jamie: I'll push subject variants + 2 alt previews to the content drive by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Cool. @marketing-ops please add this to the weekly comms calendar and set a post-send check at +48h for engagement metrics.

deploybot: Reminder: scheduled send created in Mailer for eco-cohort on 2026-05-06T09:00Z (sched id: 98765).

maria: Thanks all — will share the final segment lists and a preflight checklist once Jamie drops copy. :rocket:
